description: Comptage vélo et pédestre - Compteurs sites is a dataset listed in Saint-Nazaire Agglo - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CARENE. Jeu de données listant et localisant les compteurs des sites de comptage vélos et pédestres de Saint-Nazaire Agglomération - la CARENE (Trignac, Besné, La Chapelle-des-Marais, Donges, Montoir-de-Bretagne, Pornichet, Saint-André-des-Eaux, Saint-Joachim, Saint-Malo-de-Guersac, Saint-Nazaire). Ce jeu de données est chargé quotidiennement sur l'API de notre partenaire Eco Compteur. Coverage: Saint-Nazaire Agglomération (Loire-Atlantique). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are comptage vélo, piste cyclable, velo. The portal shows 20 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-saintnazaireagglo-fr-portal.
